name: A singleton-supported cycle correction to Byrnes's differential-poset bound
headline: A singleton-supported cycle correction to Byrnes's differential-poset bound
description: An explicit singleton-supported cycle correction improves Byrnes’s cumulative differential-poset bound, with a sharp coefficient and conditional equality results.
abstract: For every ordinary unweighted r-differential poset and n ≥ 2, we subtract an explicit nonnegative term from Byrnes's cumulative upper bound for the nth rank size. The term is the cycle rank of the preceding incidence subgraph supported on elements with a singleton successor. Singleton witnesses transfer these cycles into the next incidence graph by replacing stars with trees having the same terminals. The correction can be positive and attained on standard reflected Young-prefix examples, and its coefficient one is sharp. A singleton-successor condition gives the conjectured local recurrence; two such successors give a conditional equality characterization. The result answers the printed request for an improvement of Byrnes's inequality in an incidence-dependent form. It does not prove the general local recurrence, improve the global Fibonacci envelope, or give a combinatorial proof of strict rank growth.
